---

Load packages

```{r load packages}
library(readr)
library(Biostrings)
```

Set directory paths

```{r dir paths}
root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir(".git"))

data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-novel-mirna-target-prediction")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "input")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
```

Set file paths

```{r file paths}
input_file <- file.path(data_dir, "all_novel_miRNA.xls")
output_fasta <- file.path(results_dir, "all_novel_miRNA_mature.fa")
```

Read raw miRNA table and assign column names

```{r}
# Read tab-delimited file with no header
miRNA_df <- read_tsv(input_file, col_names = FALSE)

# Assign column names
colnames(miRNA_df) <- c("id", "mature_seq", "star_seq", "precursor_seq", "precursor_coordinate")

# Preview the data
head(miRNA_df)
```

Convert to FASTA format using mature miRNA sequence

```{r}
mature_rna <- RNAStringSet(miRNA_df$mature_seq)
names(mature_rna) <- miRNA_df$id
```

Write FASTA output

```{r}
writeXStringSet(mature_rna, filepath = output_fasta)
```
